Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood. We’d like to kick off the technical screen (ML + coding) next week. Below are proposed slots and the logistics bundle for the session — please reply with which slot works best for you and whether you prefer the coding problem in a CoderPad session or a take-home style (we can accommodate either).

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Nov 25, 10:00–11:00 (ML modeling discussion + short coding)
- Thu Nov 26, 13:00–14:00 (coding-heavy, 45m + 15m debrief)
- Fri Nov 27, 08:30–09:30 (short/early, prefer if timezone constrained)

Platform options & links:
- Live: CoderPad (session link: https://coderpad.io/session/AB12CD34)
- Hybrid: Gitpod + Colab for notebook portion (we’ll send ephemeral links)
- Take-home: we’ll provide the prompt and ask for a 48-hour return window

What to expect:
- 60 minutes total: 30m technical discussion (ML design), 25m hands-on coding, 5m wrap
- Please have a laptop with Chrome and your preferred editor; we’ll provide a plain node-based terminal inside CoderPad if needed

Attachments: I’ve attached your resume we received and a short notes file with the coding prompt variants.

Next steps: pick a slot and platform preference. Once confirmed I’ll send a calendar invite and a CoderPad link (if live).

Best,
